Product Features

  • Modular Design: This TV furniture set consists of a 180 x 40 x 45 cm TV cabinet, a 30 x 40 x 100 cm display cabinet and a 120 x 13.5 x 18 cm shelf. The set is suitable for TVs up to approx. 80 inches and meets the diverse storage and presentation needs in the living room.
  • TV cabinet design: The TV cabinet is equipped with 2 downward-opening cabinets + 1 side-opening cabinet, and provides open and semi-open shelves for categorizing and storing audiovisual equipment, sundries, etc., so that the living room no longer looks cluttered.
  • Multifunctional display case: The display case can be mounted on the wall or placed on the wall. It features two adjustable glass shelves and a transparent acrylic cabinet, combining display and storage functions to show off the treasures within.
  • Extension of the top shelf: A 120 cm long upper shelf can be used to display decorative items, green plants, etc., expanding the storage space and display space on the wall and enriching the visual impact.
  • Smart Ambient Lighting: Both the TV cabinet and display cabinet have built-in LED light strips that create a warm atmosphere and enhance the modern flair and artistic style of the living room.
  • Material and load capacity: The entire construction is made of MDF and has a recommended load capacity of 50 kg. The construction is sturdy and durable, so TVs and other items can be safely placed on the table.
  • High-gloss finish: The front of the TV cabinet and display case features a high-gloss design with a pure white look that looks stylish and bright, is easy to clean and looks like new for a long time.
  • Versatile Style: The minimalist white glossy design, which combines transparent acrylic and glass elements, easily adapts to various interior styles such as modern, lightweight, luxurious, and minimalist, visually enhancing the living room.
  • Flexible Placement: The display cabinet can be wall-mounted or placed on the floor. Thanks to flexible combination options, it is suitable for different apartment types and room layouts and combines functionality and aesthetics.
  • NOTE: This product consists of two packages and may not arrive at the same time. Please make sure both packages have arrived before you start assembling!

Descriptions

App application and manager:

1. iOS and Android systems can download the "LotusLantern" app by scanning the QR code. To do this, open a browser or other tool with the "Scan QR Code" feature and scan the "LotusLantern" QR code (the QR code is in the user manual). 2. Click on the LotusLantern app icon to open the app page. 3. If Bluetooth is not enabled in the app interface, you will see the message "An application wants to enable the Bluetooth function of this device". Click 'Allow.' 4. Simply stick the light strip to a clean, dry surface with the self-adhesive backing. Use the included tape to improve adhesion. Please test the LED light strips before installation and install them carefully. If you have any questions, please contact us.

Describe

TV cabinet set, consisting of: a TV base (dimensions: 180 x 40 x 45 cm; suitable for TVs with a screen diagonal of approx. 80 inches; has two downward-opening folding compartments and a side-opening compartment and offers both open and semi-open storage areas); a display case (dimensions: 30 x 40 x 100 cm; suitable for both wall mounting and floor installation; features a two-stage design with adjustable glass shelves and contains translucent white elements made of acrylic material); as well as a wall shelf (dimensions: 120 x 13.5 x 18 cm). Made of MDF, the set has a recommended total load capacity of 50 kg and is equipped with integrated LED strip lighting.
